The newsroom needs real events to satirise.

```gherkin
Feature: Political news monitors

  Scenario: New items arrive
    Given monitors on political news sources
    When a source publishes a new item
    Then it appears as a Reference with its kind of source
```

description.to:
The newsroom may draw on real events to satirise; satire may also be wholly invented, so a Reference is an option and not a requirement (Ryan, 2026-11-15).

```gherkin
Feature: Political news monitors

  Scenario: New items arrive
    Given monitors on political news sources
    When a source publishes a new item
    Then it appears as a Reference with its kind of source
```
